title: Refactor duplicated clamp logic
goal: Extract the duplicated min/max clamping in money.ts's clampRange and stats.ts's clampToUnitRange into one shared clamp() helper, keeping behaviour (tests) unchanged.
prompt: src/money.ts's `clampRange` and src/stats.ts's `clampToUnitRange` both inline the same min/max clamping logic. Extract it into one shared `clamp(value, min, max)` helper (a new src/clamp.ts is a reasonable place) and have both functions call it. Behaviour must not change; `npm test` must still pass.
